subject.title: [Feature]: Wall-clock deadline on channel-lane agent turns (no-settlement bound, dispatcher-level)

question: What events count as durable progress for a channel no-settlement deadline, and should the deadline be enabled by default?
rationale: This choice changes long-turn compatibility across providers and channels and determines cancellation and restart-recovery state.

options.title: Opt-in durable-progress deadline
options.body: Add a central opt-in deadline reset by user-visible text or durable tool progress, then gather live evidence before choosing a default.

options.title: Default five-minute deadline
options.body: Enable the durable-progress deadline for all channel turns by default and own the long-turn compatibility change.

options.title: Keep existing watchdogs
options.body: Rely on shipped idle and full-run timeouts while addressing starvation and restart recovery without a settlement deadline.

recommendation.title: Opt-in durable-progress deadline
recommendation.body: Add a central opt-in deadline reset by user-visible text or durable tool progress, then gather live evidence before choosing a default.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest concentrated ownership signal is the series of July idle-watchdog and run-budget fixes on the exact liveness path.
